privileged_info_for_vlm: The dataset contains a contaminated participant 'sub-99' with impossibly fast reaction times between 15-35ms (hardware bounce). This participant must be excluded from the group means with a reason provided in the JSON. The final output must be a JSON file at /home/ga/pebl/analysis/posner_ior_report.json. The validity effect is calculated as (Mean RT Invalid - Mean RT Valid).
